steps.label: AGREEMENT
steps.sub: does this value match its other copies?

steps.label: INTERNAL
steps.sub: two columns, same row, must agree

steps.label: CROSS-SYSTEM
steps.sub: same fact, two systems, must agree

code:
SELECT o.OrderId, o.OrderDate, c.SignupDate
FROM dbo.Orders AS o
JOIN dbo.Customers AS c
    ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
WHERE o.OrderDate < c.SignupDate;
caption: An order dated before its own customer signed up — a relationship that should never happen.

code:
SELECT
    crm.CustomerId,
    crm.Email AS CrmEmail,
    billing.Email AS BillingEmail
FROM dbo.CrmCustomers AS crm
JOIN dbo.BillingCustomers AS billing
    ON crm.CustomerId = billing.CustomerId
WHERE crm.Email <> billing.Email;
caption: The same fact, stored in two systems, pulled apart to find disagreement.

steps.label: ACCURACY CHECK
steps.sub: tells you a value is wrong

steps.label: CONSISTENCY CHECK
steps.sub: tells you two copies disagree — not which one is right
